QuestInfo.name: Scadur's Request
QuestInfo.0: El Nath's hunter, Scadur, says he has a problem. Find out what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Scadur says he hasn't been hunting because he's not feeling well. It seems more likely that he's hiding something. Whatever the case, he needs at least #b10#k #b#t04000051#s#k and #b#t04000052#s#k to meet his hunting goal. He also said more is always better. Collect Hector Tails and White Fang Tails, and deliver them to Scadur.
QuestInfo.2: You have delivered Hector Tails and White Fang Tails to Scadur. Ask Scadur again what's really troubling him.

0.0: This isn't easy for the great hunter of El Nath to say, but I need a favor. I haven't been feeling too well lately, so I've taken some time off from hunting. Because of that, I don't think I'll meet my hunting quotas...

yes.0: To meet my quotas, I need #bHector#k and #bWhite Fang#k tails. I need at least #b10#k of the #b#t04000051##k and #b#t04000052##k, but 100 of each would be great.

no.0: But you have what it takes to help me... Hmph.

item.0: Hm... This won't be enough. I need at least 100 Hector Tails and 100 White Fang Tails.
